lens: Shared three-area-light rig, orthographic lens at gameplay pitch (~43 deg), ortho scale 10.6 identical across all four directions

north.notes: Every rail rope lands on a post; every post lands on the deck with an iron peg; every pile carries a bearer. No orphaned geometry with the pulley hidden.

south.notes: The two-tile deck and 1.8-tile clear lane read; shore entry, bank exit, corner work area, and the east fishing edge are all rail-free as contracted.

east.notes: Turn-platform cross brace spans its corner piles; junction sills close both decking-direction seams; bank landing stones seat into the pad.

west.notes: Shore threshold beam and foot stones make a believable dry landing; nothing overhangs unsupported.
